Meant for unexpanded Epic SmartLinks (.LASTLABS[…]) but ran case-insensitively, so 'vitals.hr[1]' was cut to 'vitals]'. Now upper-case only, and the closing ] goes too.
Epic @TOKEN@ placeholders are upper case; the rule ran case-insensitively.

Meant for Epic IDs like [SQLAB12], but ran case-insensitively, so results such as 'CXR [normal]' or 'culture [pending]' lost their result. Now upper-case only, and result words ([ABNORMAL], [CRITICAL], …) are kept.
Ran case-insensitively and deleted clinical pairs: 'Eye drops (OD, OS)' lost its laterality, '(PO, IV)' its routes. Now upper-case only, and laterality / route / therapy / imaging codes are kept.
Epic also tags problems '(CMS/HCC)'; that form is now removed too.
